Key technical reqs:
- Target p95 end-to-end inference latency: 30-50ms (prefer <40ms) at 200-600 RPS steady state.

- Throughput profile: spiky; 10x bursts on market open. Need graceful degradation and fallback planning.
- Quality/cost tradeoffs: open to 4-bit/8-bit quantized models if accuracy loss <1% on eval prompts.
- Behavior: require prefix/KV cache for repeated session context and dynamic batching cap at 2-8 to preserve p95.
- Routing: multi-variant routing — route to cheaper quantized model by default, fallback to full-precision when score confidence low.
